name: Business Current Account Opening — Data Model
description: Defines all entities introduced or significantly extended by JRN-004. Four new entities are established: BusinessCustomer (Commercial Banking Core aggregate root — separate from the Retail Banking ENT-001 Customer entity; owned by CAP-002/SVC-005), BusinessAccount (commercial ledger account entity; owned by SVC-005), UltimateBeneficialOwner (UBO identification and verification record; owned by SVC-005), and DirectorRecord (director identification record; owned by SVC-005). A fifth entity, BusinessKycAssessment (owned by SVC-014), extends the KycAssessment pattern for legal persons. These entities are distinct from and not related to the JRN-001 retail entities by data model FK — the capabilities own separate representations.
design_principle: CAP-002 (Commercial Banking) owns BusinessCustomer, BusinessAccount, DirectorRecord, and UltimateBeneficialOwner. CAP-001 (Retail Banking) owns Customer and Account. There is NO shared data model or foreign key relationship between ENT-001 (Customer) and ENT-079 (BusinessCustomer). They are separate aggregate roots in separate capability domains. A natural person who is both a personal retail customer and a business director exists in two independent records in their respective capability domains. Cross-referencing (if required for 'group customer view' or enhanced monitoring) is done through a separate identity resolution service, not through a shared FK.

entities.name: BusinessCustomer
entities.description: The commercial banking aggregate root for a legal entity customer. Created by SVC-005 (Commercial Banking Core) at PH-139 as a prospect record and promoted to 'active' at PH-145 (Account Provisioning) once a BusinessAccount is opened. This is the foundational entity consumed by all downstream commercial journeys (JRN-007 Business Loan, JRN-013 Trade Finance, JRN-014 International Wire, JRN-023 Merchant Onboarding). Analogous in role to ENT-001 (Customer) in the retail domain but is a completely separate entity owned by a separate capability (CAP-002). The BusinessCustomer holds the legal entity identity; individual directors and UBOs are referenced via DirectorRecord and UltimateBeneficialOwner entities respectively.

fields.name: business_customer_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated. Immutable after creation. Must be globally unique across the bank's commercial customer estate.
fields.transparency_note: Internal identifier — not displayed as a raw UUID in any customer-facing screen. Surfaced to PER-002 indirectly via application_ref.

fields.name: company_number
fields.validation_rule: Required for limited companies and LLPs. 8-character UK Companies House registration number (zero-padded). Format: 8 digits (e.g. 01234567) or 2 letters + 6 digits for LLPs (OC123456) or other registered entities. Validated against Companies House API. Immutable after creation.
fields.transparency_note: Displayed on account opening confirmation and portal. Public identifier — not sensitive.

fields.name: legal_name
fields.validation_rule: Required. 1–200 characters. Legal registered name as returned by Companies House API. Must match Companies House record exactly (normalised for case and punctuation). Immutable after initial Companies House verification — subsequent name changes require a separate name change journey triggered by a CH name change event.

fields.name: trading_name
fields.validation_rule: Optional. 1–200 characters. Trade name if different from legal name. Free text with basic character validation. Not verified against an external source — applicant-declared.

fields.name: entity_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: limited_company | llp | partnership | sole_trader | charity | other. Determines which verification path is followed. Immutable after initial application — entity type change requires a new application.

fields.name: company_status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: active | dormant | dissolved | liquidation | administration | other. Sourced from Companies House API at PH-140. Updated on subsequent pKYC monitoring events. Application proceeds only if company_status = active at PH-140.

fields.name: registered_address
fields.validation_rule: Required. Object: line1 (required, max 100 chars), line2 (optional), city (required), postcode (required — UK postcode or international equivalent), country_code (required, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Sourced from Companies House API. Updated on CH address change events.

fields.name: trading_address
fields.validation_rule: Optional. Same structure as registered_address. Collected from applicant if trading address differs from registered address.

fields.name: incorporation_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Sourced from Companies House API. Immutable. Used in risk scoring (recently incorporated companies carry higher risk weight).

fields.name: sic_codes
fields.validation_rule: Required. Array of UK SIC 2007 5-digit codes. At least one code required. Sourced from Companies House API. Used in sector risk scoring. Maximum 4 SIC codes per Companies House registration.
fields.transparency_note: SIC codes are used for sector risk assessment in the CDD process. The risk weighting applied to specific SIC codes (e.g. money services businesses, pawnbrokers) is not disclosed to the customer.

fields.name: email
fields.validation_rule: Required. RFC 5321 email format. Max 254 characters. Primary business communication email. Unique constraint enforced at application level. Lowercase normalised.

fields.name: phone
fields.validation_rule: Required. E.164 format. Primary business contact number.

fields.name: created_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Immutable. Set at BusinessApplicationStarted event publication.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Updated on any field mutation.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: prospect | active | suspended | closed. Transitions: prospect → active (on BusinessAccountOpened, PH-145); active → suspended (compliance action); active → closed (customer request or regulatory action).

fields.name: relationship_manager_id
fields.validation_rule: Optional. FK → Staff.staff_id for PER-050. Assigned on RM-assisted applications or upon account activation for mid-market/corporate segment.

relationships.description: BusinessCustomer may hold multiple BusinessAccount records (additional accounts opened via subsequent journeys).
BusinessCustomer has one or more UltimateBeneficialOwner records (MLR 2017 Regulation 5 — natural persons with >25% ownership or control).
BusinessCustomer has one or more DirectorRecord entries (all appointed directors at time of application).
BusinessCustomer has one BusinessKycAssessment record (company-level CDD) per assessment cycle.

design_decisions.decision: BusinessCustomer is a completely separate entity from ENT-001 (Customer). There is no FK relationship between them. CAP-002 owns BusinessCustomer; CAP-001 owns Customer.
design_decisions.rationale: Commercial banking and retail banking are separate capability domains with different regulatory regimes, data models, and service owners. Merging them into a single entity would couple unrelated capabilities, violate bounded-context boundaries, and make KYC/CDD governance unclear (MLR 2017 treats natural persons and legal entities differently). A natural person who is also a director is two distinct records in two separate capability domains.

design_decisions.decision: legal_name is sourced exclusively from Companies House API (PH-140), not from the applicant's self-declaration in PH-139. The applicant-provided name in PH-139 is only used to pre-populate the CH search.
design_decisions.rationale: MLR 2017 Regulation 28(11) requires company identity verification from a reliable and independent source. Using CH as the authoritative source ensures the name in our records matches the legally registered name. Applicant self-declaration alone would not satisfy this obligation.

entities.name: BusinessAccount
entities.description: The business current account entity. Created by SVC-005 (Commercial Banking Core) in PH-145 (Account Provisioning) upon an approved BusinessApplicationDecisionMade event. The central financial entity in the commercial ledger. Extends the core account concept (see ENT-004 Account for the retail equivalent) with multi-signatory configuration, payment approval workflows, and business-specific payment rail access. Triggers FSCS SCV update (for sole traders only) and CASS registration upon creation.

fields.name: business_account_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated. Immutable. Internal identifier distinct from account_number.

fields.name: business_customer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → BusinessCustomer.business_customer_id. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: account_number
fields.validation_rule: Required. 8-digit UK account number from the bank's commercial banking sort code range. Unique within the sort code. Validated against Vocalink EISCD modulus checking. Immutable.
fields.transparency_note: Surfaced in full to PER-002 at PH-145 confirmation and portal.

fields.name: sort_code
fields.validation_rule: Required. 6-digit UK sort code in XX-XX-XX format. Allocated from the bank's commercial banking range (distinct from retail sort code range). Immutable.

fields.name: account_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: business_current | business_current_multicurrency. Set from PH-139 selection. Immutable without a product change journey.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: pending | active | dormant | closed | frozen. Transitions mirror ENT-004 Account status transitions. 'frozen' blocks all debits and credits for sanctions compliance.

fields.name: opened_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Date of BusinessAccountOpened event publication. Immutable.

fields.name: iban
fields.validation_rule: Required. IBAN format: GB + 2 check digits + 4-letter bank code + 6-digit sort code + 8-digit account number = 22 characters. Generated algorithmically. Immutable.

fields.name: bic
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 9362 BIC (8 or 11 characters). Bank's assigned BIC. Immutable.

fields.name: payment_approval_threshold
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, max 2 decimal places (GBP). Payments above this threshold require dual authorisation (second authorised user sign-off). Default: bank policy default at account opening. Configurable post-opening via a separate configuration journey.
fields.transparency_note: Configured by PER-002 at PH-146. Displayed in business portal payment settings.

fields.name: authorised_users
fields.validation_rule: Required. At least one authorised user (the primary applicant). Each AuthorisedUser: user_id (UUID), name (string), email (string, RFC 5321), role (enum: sole_authoriser | dual_authoriser | payment_initiator | view_only | admin), added_at (timestamp), added_by (UUID FK → Staff or BusinessCustomer), active (boolean). Minimum 1 sole_authoriser or 2 dual_authorisers required to ensure payment capability.
fields.transparency_note: Authorised user roster displayed to all portal users with admin role. Each user's role determines what they can see and do in the business portal.

fields.name: daily_payment_limit
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, max 2 decimal places (GBP). Aggregate daily outbound payment limit. Applies across BACS, FPS, and CHAPS. Default set by bank policy at account opening.

fields.name: payment_rails_enabled
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum values: bacs | fps | chaps | sepa (if enabled). All standard rails enabled by default at account opening. CHAPS requires separate authorisation by the business for each payment.

fields.name: fscs_eligible
fields.validation_rule: Required. Default: false for limited companies (not FSCS eligible depositors). True for sole traders and small partnerships meeting FSCS eligible depositor criteria. Must be consistent with FSCS SCV record where applicable.

relationships.description: BusinessAccount belongs to one BusinessCustomer via business_customer_id FK.

design_decisions.decision: authorised_users is stored as an array on BusinessAccount, not as a separate entity. User role assignments are considered configuration data tightly coupled to the account.
design_decisions.rationale: Authorised user configuration is account-level data — it does not exist independently of the account. Separating it into a standalone entity would add join complexity without meaningful encapsulation benefit. The array is bounded (max ~20 users per account in practice) so storing it inline is safe. User identity (authentication credentials) is still owned by SVC-100 (IAM); authorised_users on BusinessAccount stores only the account-level role assignment.

design_decisions.decision: BusinessAccount uses a distinct sort code range from personal accounts (ENT-004 Account). The two ranges are non-overlapping and allocated from the bank's Pay.UK EISCD assignment.
design_decisions.rationale: Distinct sort code ranges allow the bank to immediately identify payment traffic as business vs retail — relevant for CHAPS and BACS scheme obligations. Distinct ranges also ensure that a personal sort code and a business sort code can never be confused by downstream payment processing services.

entities.name: UltimateBeneficialOwner
entities.description: Records the identity and verification status of each natural person identified as a beneficial owner of the BusinessCustomer under MLR 2017 Regulation 5 (natural persons with >25% direct or indirect ownership or control of shares, voting rights, or right to appoint/remove majority of directors). A BusinessCustomer may have zero or more UBO records. Where no natural person meets the >25% threshold, the senior managing official(s) are recorded as UBO of last resort under MLR 2017 Regulation 5(4). Each UBO record links to the SVC-050 IdentityVerification record for that individual once their identity has been verified. This entity is the audit trail for UBO identification compliance under MLR 2017 Regulation 40.

fields.name: ubo_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated. Immutable.

fields.name: business_customer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → BusinessCustomer.business_customer_id. Immutable.

fields.name: first_name
fields.validation_rule: Required. 1–100 characters. Unicode letters, hyphens, apostrophes. Sourced from Companies House PSC data initially; updated from identity verification if discrepancy.
fields.transparency_note: Personal data of a third party (not the primary applicant). Collected under MLR 2017 legal obligation (UK GDPR Article 6(1)(c)). Privacy notice sent to the individual via verification invitation.

fields.name: last_name
fields.validation_rule: Required. Same constraints as first_name.

fields.name: date_of_birth
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Collected during identity verification (PH-142). Used as CDD matching field in PEP/sanctions screening.

fields.name: nationality
fields.validation_rule: Required once identity verification is complete. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes. Multiple nationalities stored as array. At least one required. High-risk jurisdiction nationality contributes to elevated risk in BusinessKycAssessment.

fields.name: ownership_percentage
fields.validation_rule: Required. 0.01–100.00, max 2 decimal places. Ownership percentage of shares, voting rights, or beneficial interest. Sourced from Companies House PSC data and confirmed/corrected by applicant at PH-141. Must be > 25.00 for MLR 2017 threshold unless ubo_type = senior_managing_official.
fields.transparency_note: Ownership percentages are cross-referenced against Companies House PSC filings. Discrepancies between declared and CH-registered percentages are flagged for MLRO review.

fields.name: control_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: shares | voting_rights | appointment_removal_right | senior_managing_official. Corresponds to MLR 2017 Regulation 5(1) control categories. A UBO may have multiple control types — stored as array.

fields.name: companies_house_psc_notified_date
fields.validation_rule: Optional. ISO 8601. Date on which the person was notified on the PSC register. Sourced from Companies House API. Null for senior_managing_official UBOs of last resort (not on PSC register).

fields.name: verification_status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: pending | invited | in_progress | verified | failed | waived. 'waived' requires MLRO approval (used where the UBO is an existing verified customer of the bank and re-verification is waived under MLR 2017 ongoing CDD provisions).

fields.name: verification_id
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when verification_status = verified. FK → IdentityVerification.verification_id (owned by SVC-050). References the individual identity verification record for this UBO.

fields.name: cdd_screening_result
fields.validation_rule: Optional. Populated by SVC-014 after PH-143 CDD assessment. Object containing: pep_status (enum: clear | match | pending_review), sanctions_status (enum: clear | blocked | pending_review), adverse_media_status (enum: clear | flagged | pending_review), screened_at (timestamp). Not visible to PER-002 (tipping-off prohibition).
fields.transparency_note: Screening results are AML-sensitive. Access restricted to SVC-014 and PER-052 (MLRO). Never surfaced to PER-002 or PER-050 at the PEP/sanctions detail level.

fields.name: created_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Set when UBO entity is created from Companies House PSC data at PH-141.

design_decisions.decision: cdd_screening_result is stored on UltimateBeneficialOwner (owned by SVC-005) as a field, not as a separate entity owned by SVC-014.
design_decisions.rationale: The individual-level screening result for a UBO is logically part of the UBO record — it is the outcome of screening that specific individual in the context of this business application. The company-level CDD assessment is held in BusinessKycAssessment (owned by SVC-014). Splitting UBO-level screening results into SVC-014 would require SVC-005 to make a cross-service read for basic ownership record completeness. The MLRO's audit trail for individual UBO screening is satisfied by the worm_audit_pipeline logging of the screening events.

design_decisions.decision: UltimateBeneficialOwner does not reference ENT-001 (Customer) even where the UBO is also a retail customer of the bank.
design_decisions.rationale: Retail and commercial are separate capability domains. Creating a FK from ENT-081 to ENT-001 would couple CAP-002 to CAP-001 at the data model level, violating the bounded-context principle. Identity correlation between a UBO and a retail customer — if needed — is performed by a separate identity resolution service at query time, not persisted as a FK.

entities.name: DirectorRecord
entities.description: Records each appointed director of the BusinessCustomer as identified from Companies House officer list at PH-140. All current directors must be identified and individually verified (PH-142) regardless of ownership percentage. Directors are separately screened for PEP/sanctions status in PH-143 even where they hold no ownership stake. The DirectorRecord links to the SVC-050 IdentityVerification record for the individual and to the Companies House officer identifier for audit trail continuity.

fields.name: director_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated. Immutable.

fields.name: business_customer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → BusinessCustomer.business_customer_id. Immutable.

fields.name: companies_house_officer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. The Companies House officer ID (format: varies, alphanumeric, returned in officers API response). Immutable. Used for ongoing CH monitoring — pKYC triggers on CH officer list changes.

fields.name: first_name
fields.validation_rule: Required. 1–100 characters. Sourced from Companies House officer API at PH-140.
fields.transparency_note: Personal data of a third party. Collected under MLR 2017 legal obligation.

fields.name: last_name
fields.validation_rule: Required. 1–100 characters.

fields.name: appointment_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601. Date of director appointment as registered at Companies House.

fields.name: resignation_date
fields.validation_rule: Optional. ISO 8601. Null if currently appointed. Populated from Companies House data or upon a CH director change event. A resigned director must be reviewed for ongoing KYC obligations — resignation does not automatically remove CDD obligations for the period they were a director.

fields.name: is_also_ubo
fields.validation_rule: Required. True if this director also holds >25% ownership/control (i.e. also has a UltimateBeneficialOwner record). Where true, the UBO record is the primary record; DirectorRecord exists to capture the director appointment separately.

fields.name: verification_status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: pending | invited | in_progress | verified | failed | waived. Same semantics as UltimateBeneficialOwner.verification_status.

fields.name: verification_id
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when verification_status = verified. FK → IdentityVerification.verification_id (owned by SVC-050).

fields.name: cdd_screening_result
fields.validation_rule: Optional. Same structure as UltimateBeneficialOwner.cdd_screening_result. Populated by SVC-014 at PH-143.

relationships.description: A director who is also a UBO has a corresponding UltimateBeneficialOwner record. is_also_ubo = true flags this relationship. The UBO record and DirectorRecord are separate entities — they serve different MLR 2017 obligations (UBO identification vs director verification).

design_decisions.decision: DirectorRecord is a separate entity from UltimateBeneficialOwner even where the same individual is both a director and a UBO.
design_decisions.rationale: MLR 2017 imposes distinct obligations for directors (officer verification) and beneficial owners (ownership verification). A director with no ownership stake must still be verified. A UBO with no director role must still be identified. Keeping them as separate entities with a is_also_ubo cross-reference allows independent lifecycle management (a director can resign while remaining a UBO; an ownership stake can be transferred while directorship continues).

entities.name: BusinessKycAssessment
entities.description: Company-level KYC/CDD assessment record produced by SVC-014 (KYC/AML Service) in PH-143. Extends the KycAssessment pattern established in ENT-003 (KycAssessment) for natural persons to cover the additional complexity of a legal entity assessment: company-level PEP/sanctions/adverse media screening, sector risk assessment, jurisdictional risk, UBO ownership chain screening, and aggregated risk scoring that combines company-level and individual-level findings. The MLRO (PER-052) holds accountability for this assessment. The BusinessKycAssessment is the primary audit record for the bank's MLR 2017 Regulation 28 compliance for this business customer.

fields.name: assessment_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated. Immutable.

fields.name: business_customer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → BusinessCustomer.business_customer_id (cross-service reference — not a DB FK; resolved via event payload). Immutable.

fields.name: company_sanctions_screening_result
fields.validation_rule: Required. Same structure as KycAssessment.sanctions_screening_result. Screens the company name, trading name, and Companies House number against OFSI, OFAC, UN, EU lists. Hard limit: 3,000ms (GOV-005-R02).

fields.name: company_pep_screening_result
fields.validation_rule: Required. Same structure as KycAssessment.pep_screening_result. Screens the company name for PEP-linked entities (e.g. a company directly connected to a PEP). Not the same as UBO/director PEP screening — those are captured in UltimateBeneficialOwner.cdd_screening_result and DirectorRecord.cdd_screening_result.

fields.name: company_adverse_media_result
fields.validation_rule: Required. Same structure as KycAssessment.adverse_media_result. Adverse media screening on the company name and trading name.

fields.name: sector_risk_assessment
fields.validation_rule: Required. Object: sic_code_risk_tier (enum: low | medium | high | prohibited), sector_notes (string, nullable), prohibited_sector (boolean). Prohibited sectors (e.g. unlicensed money services businesses, adult entertainment) result in automatic decline. High-sector-risk elevates overall risk_score.

fields.name: jurisdictional_risk
fields.validation_rule: Required. Object: country_of_incorporation_risk (enum: low | medium | high), operating_countries (array of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes), high_risk_jurisdiction_flag (boolean — true if any country is on FATF grey/black list or HM Treasury designated list). High jurisdictional risk contributes to EDD trigger.

fields.name: ubo_individual_assessments
fields.validation_rule: Required. Array referencing each UBO's individual screening summary. Each UboAssessmentSummary: ubo_id (UUID FK → UltimateBeneficialOwner.ubo_id), pep_status (enum), sanctions_status (enum), adverse_media_status (enum), individual_risk_contribution (enum: low | medium | high). Aggregated from UltimateBeneficialOwner.cdd_screening_result.

fields.name: director_individual_assessments
fields.validation_rule: Required. Same structure as ubo_individual_assessments but for directors not already captured in ubo_individual_assessments.

fields.name: risk_score
fields.validation_rule: Required. 0–100. Composite risk score combining: company-level findings (adverse media, sector risk, jurisdiction risk), individual UBO/director findings (PEP status, sanctions proximity, nationality risk). Scoring algorithm defined in GOV-005-R01 policy. Bands: 0–30 = standard; 31–60 = standard elevated; 61–100 = enhanced (EDD required).
fields.transparency_note: Not surfaced to PER-002 or PER-050. MLRO-only.

fields.name: risk_category
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: standard | standard_elevated | enhanced. 'enhanced' maps to EDD required (AP-B001). MLR 2017 Regulation 33 compliance.

fields.name: edd_required
fields.validation_rule: Required. Default: false. Set to true when risk_category = enhanced, or any UBO/director has pep_status = match, or high_risk_jurisdiction_flag = true.

fields.name: edd_trigger_reasons
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when edd_required = true. Enum values: pep_director | pep_ubo | high_risk_jurisdiction | complex_structure | elevated_risk_score | sector_risk_high. Multiple reasons possible.

fields.name: assessment_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Date CDD assessment completed.

fields.name: next_review_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. Calculated from assessment_date based on risk_category: standard = assessment_date + 3 years; standard_elevated = assessment_date + 2 years; enhanced = assessment_date + 1 year. Drives pKYC review scheduling.

fields.name: assessor
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: automated | manual. 'manual' requires mlro_sign_off_at to be populated.

fields.name: mlro_referral
fields.validation_rule: Required. Default: false. True when EDD required or manual MLRO review triggered.

fields.name: mlro_sign_off_by
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when mlro_referral = true and assessment outcome = cleared. FK → Staff.staff_id for PER-052.

fields.name: mlro_sign_off_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when mlro_sign_off_by is populated. ISO 8601 UTC. Immutable.

relationships.description: BusinessKycAssessment belongs to one BusinessCustomer (cross-service reference via business_customer_id).

design_decisions.decision: BusinessKycAssessment is owned by SVC-014, not by SVC-005. Individual UBO/director screening summaries are aggregated into BusinessKycAssessment even though the underlying UBO/Director records are owned by SVC-005.
design_decisions.rationale: Mirrors the JRN-001 design decision (DD-ENT003-01): MLRO accountability under POCA 2002 and MLR 2017 requires the CDD assessment to be in a single system of record under MLRO governance. SVC-014 is that system. The ubo_individual_assessments and director_individual_assessments arrays in BusinessKycAssessment contain summary data — they do not duplicate the full UBO/Director entity data stored in SVC-005.

design_decisions.decision: BusinessKycAssessment is a separate entity from KycAssessment (ENT-003). The two entities have different schemas reflecting the different CDD obligations for natural persons (JRN-001) vs legal entities (JRN-004). They share a conceptual pattern but are not a subtype/supertype relationship in the data model.
design_decisions.rationale: Attempting to model BusinessKycAssessment as a subtype of KycAssessment would create coupling between CAP-001 (Retail) and CAP-002 (Commercial) concerns at the schema level. The additional fields (sector_risk_assessment, jurisdictional_risk, ubo_individual_assessments, director_individual_assessments, edd_trigger_reasons) are commercially-specific and have no retail equivalent. Separate entities allow each to evolve independently.
